title: Introducing GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduces GPT-Rosalind, a frontier reasoning model built to accelerate drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning, and scientific research workflows.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Rosalind，一个专为生命科学领域设计的推理模型，旨在加速药物发现、基因组学分析、蛋白质推理和科学研究工作流。该模型基于前沿推理架构，能够处理复杂的科学问题，标志着 AI 在生命科学垂直领域的深度应用。

title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
raw_excerpt: Our newest audio model introduces granular audio tags that give you precise control to direct AI speech for expressive audio generation.
summary: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS，新一代文本转语音模型，支持 70 多种语言，引入精细音频标签实现语音风格的精确控制。该模型在 Artificial Analysis TTS 排行榜上获得 1211 的 Elo 评分，所有生成音频均使用 SynthID 水印，防止滥用。

title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning
raw_excerpt: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 upgrades robots' embodied reasoning, improving spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding for better autonomy. It enhances visual and spatial understanding, task planning, success detection, and introduces instrument reading capabilities. Available now via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, the model supports integration with tools like Google Search and VLAs.
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6，升级机器人的具身推理能力，显著提升空间理解、多视角感知、任务规划和成功检测能力，并新增仪表读数功能。该模型现已通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 提供，支持与 Google 搜索和 VLA 等工具集成。

title: Accelerating the cyber defense ecosystem that protects us all
raw_excerpt: Leading security firms and enterprises join OpenAI’s Trusted Access for Cyber, using GPT-5.4-Cyber and $10M in API grants to strengthen global cyber defense.
summary: OpenAI 扩大其“可信网络访问”计划，向数千名已验证的个人防御者和数百个关键软件防御团队开放 GPT-5.4-Cyber 模型。该模型是 GPT-5.4 的网络安全专用变体，旨在加强全球网络防御，同时 OpenAI 提供 1000 万美元 API 赠款支持。

title: Mind DeepResearch Technical Report
raw_excerpt:
作者: MindDR Team, Li Auto Inc
摘要: We present Mind DeepResearch (MindDR), an efficient multi-agent deep research framework that achieves leading performance with only ~30B-parameter models through a meticulously designed data synthesis and multi-stage training pipeline. The core innovation of MindDR lies in a collaborative three-agent architecture (Planning Agent, DeepSearch Agent, and Report Agent) and a four-stage agent-specialized training pipeline comprising SFT cold-start, Search-RL, Report-RL and preference alignment. With this regime, MindDR demonstrates competitive performance even with ~30B-scale models. Specifically, MindDR achieves 45.7% on BrowseComp-ZH, 42.8% on BrowseComp, 46.5% on WideSearch, 75.0% on xbench-DS, and 52.5 on DeepResearch Bench, outperforming comparable-scale open-source agent systems and rivaling larger-scale models. MindDR has been deployed as an online product in Li Auto. Furthermore, we introduce MindDR Bench, a curated benchmark of 500 real-world Chinese queries from our internal product user interactions, evaluated through a comprehensive multi-dimensional rubric system rather than relying on a single RACE metric. On MindDR Bench, MindDR achieves a state-of-the-art score of 51.8.
summary: 理想汽车发布 Mind DeepResearch (MindDR)，一个高效的多智能体深度研究框架，仅用约 30B 参数模型即达到领先性能。其核心创新在于三智能体协作架构（规划、深度搜索、报告）和四阶段训练流程，展示了小模型在复杂研究任务上的潜力。

title: Parcae: Doing more with fewer parameters using stable looped models
raw_excerpt: Parcae is one of the first stable architectures for looped language models. It achieves the quality of a Transformer twice the size with clean, predictable training. Parcae increases the recurrence rather than purely scaling data, creating a new medium to scale quality. The name Parcae is a homage to the three Roman fates: Nona, Decima, and Morta.
summary: Together AI 发布 Parcae，首个稳定的循环语言模型架构，能以两倍小 Transformer 的参数规模达到同等质量。Parcae 通过增加循环次数而非单纯扩展数据来提升性能，为语言模型提供了一种新的扩展维度，训练过程干净可预测。

title: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
raw_excerpt: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a compelling promise that parallel token generation could break the sequential bottleneck of autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, DLMs consistently lag behind AR models in quality. This gap stems from a fundamental failure of introspective consistency: AR models agree with what they generate, whereas DLMs often do not. The Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM) uses introspective strided decoding (ISD) to verify previously generated tokens while advancing new ones in the same forward pass. With gated LoRA, ISD enables bit-for-bit lossless acceleration.
summary: 研究团队提出 Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM)，通过内省步进解码（ISD）解决扩散语言模型与自回归模型之间的质量差距。ISD 在单次前向传播中同时验证已生成 token 并推进新 token，结合门控 LoRA 实现无损加速，为并行生成开辟新路径。

title: Multi-Agent Kernel Optimization
raw_excerpt: Cursor detailed a multi-agent system that optimized 235 CUDA kernels for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, achieving a 38% average speedup, with some cases exceeding 2× improvements.
summary: Cursor 详细介绍了其多智能体系统，该系统为 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 优化了 235 个 CUDA 内核，实现平均 38% 的加速，部分案例提升超过 2 倍。这项工作展示了 AI 驱动的代码优化在底层硬件性能提升中的巨大潜力。

title: Five hyperscalers now own over two-thirds of global AI compute
raw_excerpt: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, and Oracle now control two-thirds of the world's compute. Many AI labs depend almost entirely on these hyperscales for access to compute.
summary: Epoch AI 报告显示，谷歌、微软、Meta、亚马逊和甲骨文五家超大规模云服务商现已控制全球超过三分之二的 AI 算力。许多 AI 实验室几乎完全依赖这些巨头获取计算资源，这一集中化趋势引发了对 AI 生态健康度的担忧。

title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
raw_excerpt: OpenAI updates the Agents SDK with native sandbox execution and a model-native harness, helping developers build secure, long-running agents across files and tools.
summary: OpenAI 更新 Agents SDK，引入原生沙箱执行和模型原生框架，帮助开发者构建安全、可长时间运行的智能体。新 SDK 支持跨文件和工具的操作，降低了构建复杂 AI 代理的门槛，是代理开发基础设施的重要进步。
